newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police report huge cocaine bust.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police report huge cocaine bust.

text.p: Colombian police and soldiers destroyed more than a tonne of cocaine and cocaine paste during a raid on a clandestine drug laboratory in the country's southeast province of Guaviare, authorities said on Monday.
A statement from the anti-narcotics division of the National Police said the raid was part of an operation dubbed "Cuervo" or "Crow."

The drug lab, where nearly 1,600 pounds (725 kg) of cocaine and more than 630 pounds (287 kg) of cocaine paste were destroyed, was discovered in the municipality of Miraflores, capital of Guaviare, the police statement said.
It added that the sophisticated lab was comprised of eight jungle-covered barracks large enough to house 50 people.
The raid brought the amount of cocaine seized and destroyed in Colombia so far this year to more than 28 tonnes.
